Chapter 02 — Situation

4Channels / 1Taxpayer

4 Channels. 1 Taxpayer.

Revenue arrives in four different places. Tax responsibility lands on one person.

At filing time every stream has to be added back together — and today the shop owner is the one doing the adding.

From receipts to tax insights.

01 · READ

DATE AMOUNT SELLER

Three assistants working behind one screen. The seller stays the expert on their business — the system explains the tax.

Chapter 09 — Market opportunity

Start where the pain is sharpest.

฿200K – ฿1.8M

Target annual revenue band

Not accounting software for every business. Sellers whose revenue is growing, fragmented across channels, and who have no accounting department watching the numbers every day.

No TAM, SAM, SOM, seller count or market value is claimed here. Market sizing requires third-party data and must be validated before public use.
